# mizerEcopath: Extending Ecopath to Mizer

The `mizerEcopath` package provides a framework for setting up and
calibrating multi-species size spectrum models using the
[mizer](https://sizespectrum.org/mizer/) package. The size spectra are
obtained by balancing the effects of growth and mortality. In that sense
it is similar to the [Ecopath](https://ecopath.org/) model, but where
Ecopath is only concerned with balancing at the species level,
mizerEcopath balances at each size class of each species.

mizerEcopath offers tools to assist in translating empirical
observations into steady-state size spectrum models that are
ecologically coherent. If one already has an Ecopath model, it is
possible to start from parameters of that model.

## Goal

The goal is to make the process of building, tuning, and validating
mizer models more accessible, robust, and transparent. These methods
support applications ranging from academic research to exploratory
ecosystem analysis and policy-relevant fisheries modelling.

## Installation

You can install the development version of mizerEcopath from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("gustavdelius/mizerEcopath")
```

## Workflow

The typical workflow for creating a mizer model from Ecopath data
involves the following steps:

1.  **Export Ecopath Parameters**: Open your Ecopath model in “Ecopath
    with Ecosim” and export the parameters to CSV files.

2.  **Prepare Species Table**: Create a table in R with one row for each
    species you want to include in the mizer model. This table must
    contain:

    - `species`: The name of the species.
    - `w_max`: The largest observed size of the species.
    - `w_mat`: The weight at maturity.
    - `ecopath_groups`: The corresponding Ecopath group(s).

3.  **Initialize Model**: Use
    [`newAllometricParams()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/newAllometricParams.md)
    to create a mizer model based on these parameters. This sets up a
    model with allometric encounter and mortality rates, initially with
    no interactions.

    ``` r

    params <- newAllometricParams(species_params)
    ```

4.  **Match Observations**: Use various functions provided by the
    package to `matchBiomass()` to match the total biomass for each
    species,
    [`matchGrowth()`](https://sizespectrum.org/mizer/reference/matchGrowth.html)
    to match the growth rates,
    [`matchCatch()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchCatch.md)
    to match the total yield and the size distribution of the catch, and
    [`matchConsumption()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchConsumption.md)
    to match the total consumption for each species.

5.  **Tune the Model**: Use the interactive Shiny gadget
    [`tuneEcopath()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/tuneEcopath.md)
    to fine-tune the model to reproduce the observed size structure and
    other Ecopath parameters.

    ``` r

    params <- tuneEcopath(params)
    ```

    This gadget allows you to interactively adjust parameters and see
    the effects on growth, yield, and consumption in real-time.

6.  **Set predation preferences**: Use
    [`matchDiet()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchDiet.md)
    to set predation preferences in the model to match the observed diet
    compositions.

    ``` r

    params <- matchDiet(params)
    ```

## Background

Ecopath models are based on biomass pools, while mizer models are based
on size spectra. `mizerEcopath` bridges this gap by using the Ecopath
parameters (Biomass, Consumption, Production, Catch) to constrain and
inform the size-dependent parameters required by mizer.

For a detailed explanation of the theoretical background and the
translation of parameters, see the vignette
`vignettes/ecopath_to_mizer.qmd`.

# Package index

## Building model

Functions to prepare model parameters and control interaction states.

- [`newAllometricParams()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/newAllometricParams.md)
  : Set up parameters for a model with allometric encounter and
  mortality rates
- [`newVonBertalanffyParams()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/newVonBertalanffyParams.md)
  : Create model with von Bertalanffy growth rates in the steady state
- [`isAllometric()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/isAllometric.md)
  : Test whether a model has allometric encounter and mortality rates
- [`makeInteracting()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/makeInteracting.md)
  : Enable predator–prey interactions using an interaction matrix
- [`makeNoninteracting()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/makeNoninteracting.md)
  : Make model non-interacting
- [`setFeedingLevel()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/setFeedingLevel.md)
  : Set constant feeding level for each species in a non-interacting
  model
- [`setFeedingLevels()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/setFeedingLevels.md)
  : Set feeding levels while maintaining constant growth and
  reproduction
- [`bindParams()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/bindParams.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Combine several MizerParams objects

## Calibrating model

Tools to match model output to empirical observations.

- [`matchCatch()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchCatch.md)
  : Match the observed catch and yield
- [`matchConsumption()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchConsumption.md)
  : Match the model's total consumption to observed estimates
- [`matchGonadicProportionOnce()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchGonadicProportionOnce.md)
  : Match the gonadic proportion of a species to a given value.
- [`matchDiet()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/matchDiet.md)
  : Match the diet matrix of the model to an observed diet matrix
- [`alignResource()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/alignResource.md)
  : Align resource abundance to fish abundance
- [`setResourceInteraction()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/setResourceInteraction.md)
  : Set resource interaction to absorb external encounter rate

## Working with Ecopath

Functions for importing and validating data.

- [`addEcopathParams()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/addEcopathParams.md)
  : Add Ecopath parameters to species parameters
- [`addEcopathCatchTotal()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/addEcopathCatchTotal.md)
  : Sets up gear parameters from Ecopath catch data
- [`reduceEcopathDiet()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/reduceEcopathDiet.md)
  : Reduce Ecopath diet matrix to mizer species
- [`validEcopathParams()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/validEcopathParams.md)
  : Validate Ecopath parameter data frame
- [`validEcopathCatch()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/validEcopathCatch.md)
  : Validate Ecopath Catch data frame
- [`fillDefaultsFromFishBase()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/fillDefaultsFromFishBase.md)
  : Fill Species Traits Using FishBase

## Calculating rates

Extract rates and other parameters from the model.

- [`getConsumption()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getConsumption.md)
  : Get consumption rate for each species
- [`getUnassimilated()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getUnassimilated.md)
  : Get unassimilated food
- [`getProduction()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getProduction.md)
  : Get production rate as defined by Ecopath
- [`getTotalProduction()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getTotalProduction.md)
  : Get total production rate for each species
- [`getSomaticProduction()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getSomaticProduction.md)
  : Get somatic production for each species
- [`getGonadicProduction()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getGonadicProduction.md)
  : Get gonadic production for each species
- [`getOffspringProduction()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getOffspringProduction.md)
  : Get rate at which offspring biomass is produced
- [`getReproductiveLoss()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getReproductiveLoss.md)
  : Get rate of biomass loss due to reproduction
- [`getRespiration()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getRespiration.md)
  : Get respiration rate as defined by Ecopath
- [`getMetabolicRespiration()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getMetabolicRespiration.md)
  : Get metabolic respiration for each species
- [`getEcotrophicEfficiency()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getEcotrophicEfficiency.md)
  : Get Ecotrophic Efficiency for each species
- [`getM0B()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getM0B.md)
  : Get rate at which biomass is lost due to external mortality
- [`getM2B()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getM2B.md)
  : Get rate at which biomass is lost due to predation mortality
- [`getZB()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getZB.md)
  : Get rate at which biomass is lost due to mortality
- [`getDietMatrix()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getDietMatrix.md)
  : Get diet matrix
- [`getResourceEncounterRate()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getResourceEncounterRate.md)
  : Get resource encounter rate

## Plotting

Basic visualisations

- [`plotAgeLikelihood()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plotAgeLikelihood.md)
  : Plot the likelihood of the observed age at length data
- [`plotConsumptionVsSpecies()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plotConsumptionVsSpecies.md)
  : Plot the Consumption against species
- [`plotDeathX()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plotDeathX.md)
  [`plotlyDeathX()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plotDeathX.md)
  : Plot the sources of external, predation and fishing mortality per
  species and size
- [`plotProductionVsSpecies()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plotProductionVsSpecies.md)
  : Plot the production against species
- [`plot_catch()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plot_catch.md)
  : Plot observed catches against modelled catches
- [`plot_log_likelihood()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/plot_log_likelihood.md)
  : Plot Signed Negative Log-Likelihood Contributions with Mean K Lines
  Creates a heatmap of the signed contribution of each cell to the NLL,
  and overlays the mean observed and expected K values.

## Helper functions

Internal tools to support calibration and simulation.

- [`prepare_data()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/prepare_data.md)
  : Prepare a TMB Objective Function for Optimising Model Parameters
- [`update_params()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/update_params.md)
  : Prepare a TMB Objective Function for Optimising Model Parameters
- [`precompute_weights()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/precompute_weights.md)
  : Precompute weights for integration of density over observed bins
- [`valid_catch()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/valid_catch.md)
  : Validate and extract catch data for a single species
- [`addCatch()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/addCatch.md)
  : Sets up gear parameters from scaled catch data
- [`age_mat_vB()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/age_mat_vB.md)
  : Calculate age at maturity from von Bertalanffy growth parameters
- [`tuneParams_update_abundance()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/tuneParams_update_abundance.md)
  : Update the abundance of a species

## Diffusion

Functions for solving diffusion equations in mizer models.

- [`solve_double_sweep()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/solve_double_sweep.md)
  : Helper function for double sweep method (Thomas algorithm)
- [`project_diffusion()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/project_diffusion.md)
  : Project forward in time with diffusion
- [`solve_diffusion_pde()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/solve_diffusion_pde.md)
  : Function to solve a reaction-diffusion-advection PDE

## Age-at-length

Functions for working with age at size.

- [`calculate_and_aggregate_likelihood()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/calculate_and_aggregate_likelihood.md)
  : Calculate and Aggregate Signed Log-Likelihood Contributions Loops
  through surveys, calculates signed NLL for each, and aggregates the
  results.
- [`generate_model_predictions_for_date()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/generate_model_predictions_for_date.md)
  : Generate age-at-length distribution for a specific survey date
- [`getLogLik()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/getLogLik.md)
  : Get log likelihood of age observations
- [`simulateCohort()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/simulateCohort.md)
  : Simulate cohort evolution and calculate matrix G
- [`preprocess_length_at_age()`](https://gustavdelius.github.io/mizerEcopath/reference/preprocess_length_at_age.md)
  : Pre-process length-at-age data frame
